title: Game Data Missions 11E terrain layout visual references

source.role: visual reference, parity QA, and reconstruction aid only

officialAuthority.title: Warhammer 40,000 Event Companion
officialAuthority.precedence: GDM never overrides official v1.2 identity, geometry, objectives, terrain footprints, orientation, or measurements.

preservation.reason: No repository policy was found authorizing redistribution of 90 third-party image assets.
preservation.reproducibility: URLs, HTTP status, content type, pixel dimensions, byte sizes, SHA-256 hashes, retrieval date, and official parity are recorded.

notes: The 25 ordered UI selections collapse to 15 unordered factual matchups; A+B and B+A are not separate matchup facts.
Every matchup has three layouts. Official A/B/C maps to GDM 1/2/3.
All GDM assets were fetched successfully as 1653x2833 PNG files on 2026-09-22.
The live host is game-datamissions.com while its embedded canonical metadata names gdmissions.app; the recorded asset URLs use the requested live host.
A -portrait filename means attacker-left/defender-right presentation; it does not indicate a rotation discrepancy from official v1.2.
The GDM measurement overlays include derived coordinate-style guidance and occasional decimal rounding, so official v1.2 remains the measurement authority.

setupDistanceAssessment.note: GDM recasts official placement into edge-anchored coordinate callouts and adds labels/legend; some displayed values are rounded. It is QA/reconstruction guidance, not an official measurement owner.
